newsitem.title: USA: Dec Q2 gross margins fall to 32.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Dec Q2 gross margins fall to 32.6 pct.

text.p: Ditital Equipment Corp said Thursday gross margins for the quarter was 32.9 percent, compared with 32.6 percent for the same period in the prior year and 31.3 percent in the first quarter of the current fiscal year.

Product gross margin was 34.5 percent, compared with 32.5 percent in the second quarter a year ago and 31.1 percent in the first quarter of fiscal 1997. Service gross margin was 30.9 percent compared with 32.7 percent in the comparable period last year and 31.5 percent in the first quarter of fiscal 1997.
Total operating expenses for the quarter were $1.067 billion, down 6 percent from a year ago.
The company ended the quarter with about 55,900 employees, down 1,100 from the prior quarter.
Product revenue was $1.844 billion compared to $2.347 billion in the second quarter of last year. However, product revenue was up 21 percent from the first quarter of fiscal 1997.
DIGITAL'S service revenue was $1.513 billion compared to $1.604 billion reported for the same period last year. Service revenue was up 9 percent on a sequential basis.
Over the past month, the company, in separate actions, lowered the price of its leading 64-bit Alpha microprocessors and its AlphaServer and AlphaStation line.
